$schema: Product catalog — single source of truth. A product can belong to multiple collections (see docs/phase-2-information-architecture.md §6), so 'collections' is an array of collection slugs from data/collections.json, not a single category field. This is a seed set spanning the first collections; Phase 9 expands full catalog coverage across all 17 collections. 'images' are verified royalty-free Pexels placeholders (mood-matched, not literal product photos) per the project's IMAGES brief — swap for real studio photography as it's shot.

products.name: Personalized Couple Photo Resin Frame
products.shortDescription: A hand-poured resin frame personalized with your photo, names, and date.
products.description: Your photo is sealed under crystal-clear epoxy resin inside a hand-finished birch frame, bordered with a fine gold-leaf edge and your names and date engraved along the base. Each frame is cast individually, so bubbles and imperfections are hand-corrected before final polish rather than mass-produced.
